Mods in "hidden" are not listed (engine patches and other mods with nothing to do on 1.21.1, client-side mods that have their own 1.21.1 version); the tools/compat scripts skip them. "hidden_by_mc" lists mods hidden for one Minecraft version only (1.20.1: client-side-only mods, which the 1.20.1 work skips).

mods.name: AbyssalCraft
mods.notes: Survival-tested 2026-11-01: the Gateway Key builds the portal and a survival player enters the Abyssal Wasteland; all four dimensions load with their own biomes; 166 blocks break and drop, 440 recipes and the chest/mob loot tables load, mobs drop their loot. The Transmutator burns fuel and cooks; the ritual altar runs a ritual end to end (range charm: pedestal offerings consumed, charm dropped). Chagaroth (damage cap, spawns, fists) dies and drops dread keys, dreadium and XP; Jzahar spawns and drops a scroll. Server-tested 2026-11-01 (second pass): crystallizer (shards, fuel), engraver (azathoth coin, engraving wears) and materializer (bag of crystals lists the recipe) work with valid recipe inputs; the sacrificial altar collects Potential Energy from a slain cow; the relay moves PE collector -> container; NecroDataCapability (Necronomicon unlocks) works; all 47 non-projectile entity types spawn and tick; plague and antimatter effects apply. Still untried: the other sacrifice rituals, spirit altar and statues, the Necronomicon GUI, Dreadlands/Omothol structure chests, tool/armour effects, Asorah/Sacthoth/Gatekeeper/Jzahar phases. Known: the mod's ACExplosion scheduler indexes Chunk.getBlockStorageArray with y<0 in 1.21 worlds (blocks below y=0 exist) and throws every tick until the explosion finishes (large Dread/antimatter bombs only). Known: with C2ME some Omothol chunks log a populate error (mob random used off-thread; being fixed). Item models of crystal subtypes and OBJ weapons fixed after 0.3.13 (#129).

mods.name: The Twilight Forest
mods.notes: Real client, survival, shaders: the ironwood axe recipe gives its result from the crafting grid (the 3 recipes with an empty result are code recipes). Earlier checks: blocks, items and several mobs render; hostile mobs and the dimension were not checked. 2026-11-07 round: the dimension generated nothing (void) because MapGenStructure.getStructureName was abstract; fixed. Portal (diamond into the flower pool) forms and teleports, terrain and trees generate, mobs (lich, knight phantom, tower golem, redcap, druid, minotaur, boar, deer, penguin) render with boss bars; the Naga draws as a leaf cube (issue #190). 2026-11-07 (later): the Naga no longer draws as one leaf cube: the legacy renderer draws its body segments through RenderManager.renderEntitySimple, which drew them all at the camera origin (now at the entity's position), and the Naga's own class recursed forever (StackOverflowError that crashed the server) because the mod method getMaximumHomeDistance() collided with the forward rename of the SRG func_110174_bM it calls (now renamed locally); the boss bar of a boss the player left (other dimension) or that unloaded is removed; entities created from a bare spawner/summon tag no longer run the legacy NBT read (the Naga's 'Home' list). Not fixed: purple oversized square particles at a killed Naga's position (issue #190 stays open).

mods.name: The Twilight Forest
mods.notes: Real client, survival, shaders: init succeeds; the wild boar, bighorn sheep, bunny and penguin draw with their models. A skeleton druid and a hedge spider spawned in survival walked up, attacked and killed the player (poison effect, damage, knockback): mob AI and attacks work. Dimension, structures and bosses not explored. Real client 2026-11-07: the dimension generates and renders (forest, ponds); the hydra, naga, tower golem and goblin knight spawn and draw with boss bars (the hydra crashed the client with a ClassCastException until EntityLiving.despawnEntity was made server-only). Mob sounds are unknown sound events (#195).
